purpose: Formalize finite-memory Bollinger and recursive Wilder ADX behavior across certified same-identity price-basis resets without weakening W0, parent, PIT or continuity gates.

constraints: same a,b apply to the certified pre-event price prefix mapped into the target post-event price basis
no per-bar nonlinear rounding unless separately proved replay-equivalent
affineTransformDefinition.notAuthority: This theorem does not certify that any real corporate action is affine; the corporate-action continuity receipt must certify the transform.

adxMatureStateTheorem.scope: Only a fully initialized mature Wilder state after the first valid ADX exists.
proofSketch: All H/L/C differences under a uniform positive affine transform are multiplied by a; b cancels.
TR and directional-movement ordering/sign tests are preserved for a>0, so one-bar TR/+DM/-DM are multiplied by a.
Wilder smoothing is linear in the price-dimensional input states, so smoothed TR/+DM/-DM are multiplied by a.
+DI and -DI are ratios of equally scaled numerator/denominator and are unchanged.
DX and the mature ADX recurrence consume only dimensionless DI/DX values, so they are unchanged.
After transforming the previous H/L/C and price-dimensional mature state, the next target-basis bar produces the same continuation as full replay on the affine-transformed prefix.

bollingerFiniteMemoryTheorem.exactRule: Bollinger output at t depends only on the exact 20 eligible closes in the frozen formula.
bollingerFiniteMemoryTheorem.postResetAmnesia: If all exact 20 eligible closes are strictly after the last certified price-basis reset and within one continuing security identity/price space, any older pre-reset price history has zero direct formula influence.
bollingerFiniteMemoryTheorem.mixedWindowRule: If any retained close in the exact 20-session window is pre-reset, RAW pre/post prices may not be mixed. Use certified transformed retained closes or fail closed.
bollingerFiniteMemoryTheorem.affineBufferRule: For a certified affine reset, applying P'=aP+b to every retained pre-reset close in the rolling buffer yields the same Bollinger result as replaying that exact transformed 20-close window, subject to identical rounding semantics.
bollingerFiniteMemoryTheorem.noShortcut: POST_RESET_20_CLEAN_SESSIONS does not replace W0 technical-continuity acceptance, genuine parent identity, Layer-C known-at, exact session or source-hash gates.

finiteVsRecursiveMemory.implication: A sufficiently old reset can leave Bollinger's exact 20-session formula entirely, while ADX cannot claim amnesia merely from elapsed bars. ADX needs full replay, replay-certified trusted state, or a separately proved state-transform equivalence.

D03-10.benefit: Explains and machine-tests finite-memory contamination expiry; future parent-specific Bollinger acceptance may use a clean post-reset 20-session suffix without requiring transformed history older than that suffix.
D03-10.nonCredit: REAL_W0_CONTINUITY_RECEIPT and GENUINE_V8_20_PARENT remain required under the current promotion oracle.

D03-09.benefit: Defines a mathematically valid candidate route for replay-certified trusted-state transformation under a certified affine same-identity reset.
D03-09.nonCredit: Canonical FULL_REPLAY/trusted-state gate is not relaxed until exact implementation parity, rounding semantics and lineage certification are physically proven.
